name: agent-receipts
description: See exactly what your coding agent did, step by step and agent by agent, and rewind your files to any step.

interface.shortDescription: Audit trail and rewind for Codex runs
interface.longDescription: Records every Codex tool call with the agent that made it and a hidden git snapshot of your files. Open a .receipt to drill from modules to files to the exact diff, see which subagent broke what, and rewind your files to any step. Every rewind is undoable.
defaultPrompt: @Agent Receipts show me what the agent did in this repo.
